description: Register wardens, office, mess and security staff and tick **Create Desk Login** to give them a desk login. Every Hostel360 desk role requires two-factor authentication, so each person links an authenticator app the first time they sign in. Deputy wardens, office, mess and security staff only see the hostels they are assigned to; security staff only record students leaving and returning at the gate.
name: Register Hostel Staff
title: Register staff with two-factor sign-in
